data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 557 closed 2016 with opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 27.076m and experienced a modest favourable prior-year development, approximately a GBP 2.0m gross release (around 7.4% of opening reserves). The movement reflects reassessment and favourable development across prior accident years rather than material single large losses; 2016 catastrophe events (Canadian Wildfires, Hurricane Matthew) did not produce large losses for the syndicate. The reserve release is small and primarily attributable to favourable claims development in the reinsurance (treaty) book.
raw_causal_phrases: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 1.9m (2015: GBP 2.4m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

2016 saw an increase in catastrophe activity compared to recent years, with the occurrence of the Canadian Wildfires and Hurricane Matthew. Neither of these events, however, produced a large loss for us, resulting in a satisfactory performance for the year.
The 2014 underwriting year result improved by GBP 0.5m as a result of a reduction in prior years' reserves on catastrophe losses.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (gross) was calculated from the published gross claims development (triangle) because the explicit narrative sentence quoted the NET reassessment (GBP 1.9m). The gross triangle-derived PYD is -GBP 2.0m (release) which is consistent with the net figure; confidence is moderate-high. No RITC distortion was evident for Syndicate 557. All amounts converted from displayed GBP '000s to millions where applicable.
